title: Semiconductor
content: Materials which have an electrical resistance that lies between the high resistance values of insulators and the low resistance values of metals are called semiconductors[cite: 1].

title: P-N Junction Diode
content: A device which consists of a boundary or junction formed between p-type and n-type semiconductors is called a p-n junction diode[cite: 1].

title: Rectifier
content: A rectifier is a device which converts an alternating current (AC) into a unidirectional current or a direct current (DC)[cite: 1].

title: Transistor
content: A transistor is a semiconductor device which works as an amplifier[cite: 1].

title: Bit
content: A bit is the abbreviation of the words binary and digit, representing the smallest unit of memory or instruction that can be given or stored on a computer[cite: 1].

title: Logic Gate
content: A logic gate is an electronic device which takes information from the environment, makes a decision based on that information and then gives out the result[cite: 1].
